digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics surface + rebar-janitor skill + project documentation
propositions: rebar-janitor's Discovery phase does not currently consult rebar metrics as historical code-health evidence, missing the trend dimension that complements snapshot tools like cloc/tokei/ast-grep
rebar metrics command and registry exist but are not discoverable in project documentation, making them a dead-end artifact for tools and contributors
the four metric lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics) and their unavailable/accruing_since state must be documented so agents do not misinterpret absence as zero
the MetricSpec/REGISTRY declarative registry and is_authoritative segregation are not referenced in reuse documentation, preventing library consumers from discovering the subsystem
